other_conditions: Applicant must be a member of a registered fishermen cooperative society
The cooperative society must be affiliated with JHASCOFISH
The society should actively participate in fish production or related activities
Societies with pending legal cases or misuse of prior funds are not eligible
benefits_summary: Provides financial grants, equipment, infrastructure development, marketing support, welfare programs, and vehicle purchase assistance to registered fishermen cooperative societies.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
